buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 25% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 25 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 25 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 25 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Additional Terms & Conditions (ATC) 1. The Vehicle offered should be of following make and model:-AMRITSAR CHARGE Make Contract Tenu S. No. Vehicle Model Number re 1 Toyota Innova Crysta 2023 or above 1 3 year 2. The Vehicle should be registered preferably in Punjab and must be in good working condition. The vehicl e provided to the department shall be white in color. 3. The vehicle provided by the vendor should not have run more than 25000 KM, however the clause will be relaxed if the condition of the vehicle is good and satisfies the requirement of the department. 4. The Vehicle will be required to run maximum of 2000 kilometers per month. The unused Kms. of a month will be carried forward to the subsequent months till the end of year. The unused kilometers would mean t he difference between agreed kilometers i.e. 2000 Kms. run in a month and actual kilometers run by a veh icle if it is less than the agreed kilometers. The year-end unused kilometers won’t be carried forward to ne xt year. Roll over payment settlement will be done at the end of year. 5. The Cost of Ceiling of petrol/Diesel Vehicle should be as per office memorandum vide F.No. G/1/2019/FU/ EC-II dated 11.02.2019 :- Type of Vehicle Cost of ceiling (exclusive of taxes) ( S. No. in Rs.)

1. Small Size 40,000/- per month Mid-sized and SUV vehicles 50,000/- per month 2. 6. As on 01.01.2026, the contractor must have at least 3 years of previous experience of running operational vehicles in Govt. Department/Public Sector Units. The Annual Turnover of the service provider/contractor s hould not be less than Rs. 30 lakhs for each of last three Financial Years 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26 an d a certified copy of balance sheet, profit & loss account and Income Tax Returns for A.Y. 2023-24 and AY 2024-25 and certificate from Govt. Department/Public Sector Units as proof of turnover for the AY 2025-26 must be enclosed as proof. 7. The Vehicle will be required to run maximum of 2000 kilometers per month. The unused Kms. of a month will be carried forward to the subsequent months till the end of year. The unused kilometers would mean t he difference between agreed kilometers i.e. 2000 Kms. run in a month and actual kilometers run by a veh icle if it is less than the agreed kilometers. The year-end unused kilometers won’t be carried forward to ne xt year. Roll over payment settlement will be done at the end of year. 8. For extra KM, the payment will be made @ Rs 15/KM for the vehicles - Toyota Hycross/Toyota Innova Cryst a and Rs 12/KM for Maruti Ertiga/XL-6/KIA Carens/Toyota Rumion. 9. The Vehicle provided by the Contractor should be made available on all days including holidays on round the clock basis. Non- providing of vehicle/ alternate equivalent vehicle on any day/s will attract deduction of charges from the bill on pro- rata basis. 10. The Service Provider will not replace the attached vehicle under any circumstances, except during periods when the vehicle is undergoing repair or maintenance. However, during such repair or maintenance period s, the Service Provider will arrange for a suitable substitute vehicle of the same type. The seller to whom c ontract is awarded would furnish R.C. details of all hired vehicle. 11. The Driver to be provided by the contractor with the vehicle, should be in uniform (will be provided by the contractor) while on duty or as per the guidelines of the RTO. The following conditions are also to be fulfille d by the contractor/ driver:- a) The driver should have a valid driving License and experience of more than three years of driv ing the class of vehicle offered for hire. b) The driver shall be provided with a mobile phone by the Contractor. The bill of the mobile pho ne is to be borne by the contractor. The driver should always be reachable on mobile phone du ring the period of his deployment. c) The driver should be decent and well behaved. He should not have any criminal background. I t shall be the responsibility of the Contractor to verify the antecedents of the driver before dep loyment. The Contractor should submit the Police Verification Report and also the past job hist ory (3 years) with details of employer and contact, of the new driver before assigning him on a ny vehicle. d) The Contractor shall be responsible for verification of medical fitness and suitability of driver b efore deployment. e) The driver should have knowledge of city routes and should be able to communicate both in Hindi and English. f) All statutory compliances related to employment of the driver need to be adhered to by the c ontractor. g) Dedicated driver is to be provided to the Department. Any change would be permitted only in exceptional circumstances, with prior permission. h) The personnel deployed by the Contractor shall maintain decency, peace and order during dep loyment with the department. He shall behave courteously with all the officers/ employment of

the department, other personal working for the department and the visitors of the office/ resid ential premises. The driver/ personnel would be required to be immediately replaced by the Co ntractor on complaint of misbehavior. Any damage to property by the deployed personnel shall be recovered from the contractor. i) The contractor has to ensure that the drives employed will be paid minimum wages as per th e prescribed norms in the district. j) Duty hours of driver and vehicle will be from 9.00 am to 8.00 pm. During work contingency o r outstation trips, where driver have to work beyond the above working hours, night charges fo r both outstation or within station will be paid @ Rs. 250/- per night. k) With respect to night charges, maximum 15 nights per month per vehicle will be allowed. The contractor to ensure that the Driver of vehicle cannot be changed without prior per mission of concerned officers. 12. Claims/damages arising out of accident, if any shall be settled by the contractor. 13. The Contract will be for period of 3 year with effect from the date of signing of agreement and may be re newed on mutual agreement (if found satisfactory) by the department, on the same terms and conditions or such modification as agreeable to both the parties. 14. The vehicle shall have comprehensive insurance and fitness as per the RTO rules and compliance to the p rovisions of the Motor Vehicle Act/ Rules. All legal obligations in respect of the vehicle i.e. road Tax, RTO p ermissions etc. and the driver i.e. minimum wage, social security etc. will be the responsibility of the contr actor. 15. The Seller should keep the following documents to justify their capacity to execute the contract:- Certifica te of registration of vehicle, insurance of vehicle, road tax certificate, emission test certificate etc. in origin al. 16. The vehicle should be registered as public service vehicle (commercial vehicle) with the competent autho rities of the U.T./ State Government. 17. The vehicle is to be maintained in excellent condition and regular cleaning and servicing must be ensured . 18. In addition to the penalties as per Clause 8 of the Service Level Agreement (SLA) stipulated on GeM 4.0 (V ersion 1.13), following will be applicable in case of stated violation: a) In case a lower category vehicle was provided, in contravention to the vehicle as mandated in the paragraph 1 of ATC, 20% of the payment will be deducted on pro-rata basis. b) In case the vehicle provided is not upto mark and not as per the required standard, same has to be replaced within stipulated time, failure to do so will attract deduction of 20% charges fro m the bill on pro- rata basis. 19. The basic fixed monthly hire charges shall cover the fuel charges for vehicle, repairs and maintenance ser vicing, insurance, permit, statutory dues, taxes, other risks and liabilities of driver’s salary. Parking charge s & Toll Taxes will be reimbursed on actual basis. No request for any extra payment would be entertained. TDS will be done as per the provisions of the Income Tax Act, 1961 while making payments. 20. Payment shall be made by the O/o the Pr. CIT (AU)-1, Amritsar after the end of every month on presentati on of the bill within a reasonable time. However, no interest is payable on delayed payment. 21. The Seller to whom contract is awarded would furnish name, address and contact number of a person wit h whom the department/ controlling officer (of the Department) should contact, in case of any problem fac ed with regard to service being provided by such contractor on day to day basis. 22. A daily record indicating time and mileage for each vehicle is to be maintained in a log book and entries t herein must be certified by the user. 23. The vehicle taken on hire would have to be parked in the respective office premises.

24. Mileage will be counted from the respective Income Tax Office. Mileage and time consumed for fueling, re pair and maintenance of vehicle will be excluded. 25. Any violation of the aforementioned terms and conditions and if the services are not found satisfactory ma y lead to termination of the contract. Further the contract can be terminated at any time, without assignin g any reasons, by the Department or the contractor by giving one month notice. 26. Further if the contractor/vendor wishes to withdraw the services anytime in the contract period, he has to give notice period of 2 months or till new contractor is finalized for service, whichever is later. 27. In case of any dispute regarding the interpretation of any terms and conditions of the tender/ contract, the decision of the Pr. Commissioner of Income Tax (AU)-I, Amritsar will be final and binding. 28. The service provider/contractor should have a registered office in Amritsar as on 01/01/2026. .
